pythonFunction.name: get_appointment_eta
pythonFunction.description:
Gives the live status of an appointment: scheduled, en route or delayed, with the expected
arrival and any delay. When the delay is over 30 minutes the agent offers to reschedule. Needs
an identified caller. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while
it runs.

Args:
    appt_id: Appointment id from get_active_appointments (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, status, eta, delay_minutes and proactive_reschedule_offer.
